name: Nines
long_description:
Nines builds autonomous robots, and the models that run them, for data centers.

The AI buildout is the biggest construction project of our lifetime, and the physical work inside it is still done by hand. Every GPU rack needs thousands of fiber connections matched, inserted, and verified before a hall goes live. After that, every building needs people on site around the clock to swap drives, transceivers, and fans.

With our robots operators bring capacity online faster, with fewer errors and less downtime.
one_liner: Robot pit crew for AI data centers
